subject: Transitive access attestation & SOC 2 appendix - supply chain questions
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@novamed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: RiskOps Team <riskops@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Transitive access + SOC 2 appendix request

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the engagement last week. As part of Novamed's vendor intake we need a short attestation and some supporting artifacts related to transitive access within Redwood's runtime. Specifically we need:

- A roster of subprocessors that can access customer runtime data (KV cache, prefix cache, logs) and their residency (region/country).
- Whether any subprocessors have standing access (non-ephemeral) to those artifacts.
- KMS/residency details and whether ephemeral keys are used for customer sessions.
- A SOC 2 appendix or short attestation addressing transitive access controls (we'll include it in our vendor pack).

Attached is our SIG-lite questionnaire excerpt with the fields we need filled (Novamed_SIG_questions.xlsx). Can you confirm if you can provide the roster + attestation by COB Aug 16? If not, please propose a timeline and a point of contact for artifacts.

Best,
Elena Park
Senior Security Engineer, Novamed Health

Attachment: Novamed_SIG_questions.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@novamed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-11T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Transitive access + SOC 2 appendix request

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura (Security PM) and Jonas (Platform infra) so we can coordinate answers and evidence. Quick answers / plan below:

- Subprocessor roster: we can provide a CSV export with residency and access scope.
- Standing access: short answer — production runtime access is restricted to a small set of operational subprocessors; most access is ephemeral via short-lived tokens. We will flag any exceptions where a vendor has persistent access (rare).
- KMS & ephemeral keys: we use a layered KMS model; customer session keys are ephemeral by default and bound to tenant sessions. Jonas can add details on key rotation and residency.
- SOC 2 appendix: we can provide a short appendix that maps our controls to the SIG-lite questions and a signed attestation.

Proposed next steps:
1) I will send the subprocessor roster CSV and a preliminary SOC 2 appendix PDF by EOD Aug 12.
2) Laura will own the evidence checklist and will upload any artifacts to a shared Drive.
3) If you need a signed DocuSign appendix, we can route through our legal team — please confirm.

Would you like a 30-min sync to walk through the roster and sensitive items? We have availability Aug 12 2pm PT or Aug 13 morning.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Strategic Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_subproc_roster_20260811.csv (CSV stub)

From: Elena Park <elena.park@novamed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: RiskOps Team <riskops@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Transitive access + SOC 2 appendix request

Hi Ben — thanks, that timeline helps. A few clarifications from our side:

- Scope: production runtime only (no dev/test environments).
- Residency: please include country-level residency for any persistent storage or backups.
- KMS: confirm whether customer keys ever leave our chosen region and whether any HSM vendor holds mirror keys.
- DocuSign: we do require a signed appendix for procurement; please confirm if Redwood can sign or if we should accept an email-attested appendix with a legal follow-up.

We can do the 30-min sync Aug 13 9:30am PT. Please send a calendar invite and an agenda (roster review + remaining open questions).

On a related note, we may ask for a small sample of audit logs confirming access events for a service account — we will scope that if needed.

Thanks,
Elena

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@novamed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-13T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Transitive access + SOC 2 appendix request

Elena — thanks for confirming scope. Follow-up and deliverables:

Deliverables attached:
- SOC 2 appendix (soc2-appendix-transitive-access.pdf) — short narrative mapping our controls to the SIG-lite items you flagged.
- Evidence checklist (evidence-checklist.xlsx) — owner assignments and links to artifact bundles.
- Subprocessor roster (CSV already shared in prior mail) — in case you missed it, I re-attached.

Key points:
- Production only: confirmed.
- Persistent access: two operational subprocessors have standing access for troubleshooting (names and residency included in the roster). All others use short-lived credentials.
- KMS: customer session keys are ephemeral; backups are encrypted under regional KMS keys. No mirror HSM outside the selected residency without explicit contractual agreement. Jonas: see the KMS bullets below for technical specifics.

Jonas Weber (platform infra)
- Key rotation cadence: 90 days for regional KMS; session keys rotate per-session (~minutes).
- Audit logs: we can produce redacted access logs for the two operational subprocessors for a scoped window (30 days) under an NDA.

Next steps:
1) We'll upload the artifacts to the Drive link below and route a DocuSign appendix by EOD Aug 14.
2) Laura will be the contact for evidence uploads and will respond to any follow-up SIG items.
3) If you need the redacted logs, please send a narrow request (dates, accounts) and we'll scope.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/redwood/diagrams/runtime-dataflow
DocuSign ref: DOCUSIGN-REQ-7781

Thanks — we'll send the signed appendix as soon as legal completes review.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Sr. Strategic Security Liaison, Redwood Inference

Attachments: soc2-appendix-transitive-access.pdf (PDF stub); evidence-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub); redwood_subproc_roster_20260811.csv (CSV stub)
